story.text: 하늘은 손님을 다시 그 공항으로 불러냈다. 두 사람이 처음 마주쳤던, 바로 그 게이트 앞으로.
story.reading: ha-neul-eun son-nim-eul da-si geu gong-hang-eu-ro bul-leo-naess-da. du sa-ram-i cheo-eum ma-ju-chyeoss-deon, ba-ro geu ge-i-teu ap-eu-ro.
story.en: Haneul asked her to meet him at that same airport once more. Right in front of the very gate where the two of them had first crossed paths.

story.text: '…기억해요? 그날, 여기서 손님 탑승권 주워줬던 거.' 하늘의 목소리는 평소보다 조금 낮게 가라앉아 있었다.
story.reading: '…gi-eok-hae-yo? geu-nal, yeo-gi-seo son-nim tap-seung-gwon ju-weo-jwoss-deon geo.' ha-neul-ui mok-so-ri-neun pyeong-so-bo-da jo-geum naj-ge ga-ra-anj-a iss-eoss-da.
story.en: '...Do you remember? That day, right here, when I picked up your boarding pass.' Haneul's voice had sunk a little lower than usual.

story.text: '저 원래 이런 거 잘 못 해요. 그래도 오늘은 고백 좀 하려고요.' 그는 숨을 한 번 고르고, 천천히 말을 이었다.
story.reading: 'jeo won-lae i-reon geo jal mos hae-yo. geu-rae-do o-neul-eun go-baek jom ha-ryeo-go-yo.' geu-neun sum-eul han beon go-reu-go, cheon-cheon-hi mal-eul i-eoss-da.
story.en: 'I'm really not good at this sort of thing. But today, I'm going to make a confession anyway.' He took a breath and slowly continued.

story.text: '팬사인회도, 콘서트도, 다 진심이었어요. 근데 사실은요, 그거보다 훨씬 전부터 시작된 마음이었어요.'
story.reading: 'paen-sa-in-hoe-do, kon-seo-teu-do, da jin-sim-i-eoss-eo-yo. geun-de sa-sil-eun-yo, geu-geo-bo-da hwol-ssin jeon-bu-teo si-jag-doen ma-eum-i-eoss-eo-yo.'
story.en: 'The fan-signing, the concert — all of it was sincere. But honestly, this feeling started a long time before any of that.'

story.text: '그 인파 속에서 딱 한 번 스친 얼굴을, 저는 그날부터 계속 찾고 있었어요. …이게 운명이라면, 웃기지만 저는 믿을래요.'
story.reading: 'geu in-pa sog-e-seo ttak han beon sseu-chin eol-gul-eul, jeo-neun geu-nal-bu-teo gye-sok chaj-go iss-eoss-eo-yo. …i-ge un-myeong-i-ra-myeon, us-gi-ji-man jeo-neun mid-eul-lae-yo.'
story.en: 'That one face I glimpsed just once, in that crowd — I've been looking for it ever since that day. ...If this is fate, it sounds ridiculous, but I think I want to believe it.'

story.text: '앞으로도 팬으로, 그리고 그냥 저로도, 손님 곁에 있고 싶어요. 무대 위에서든, 이렇게 평범한 순간이든 상관없이.'
story.reading: 'ap-eu-ro-do paen-eu-ro, geu-ri-go geu-nyang jeo-ro-do, son-nim gyeot-e it-go sip-eo-yo. mu-dae wi-e-seo-deun, i-reoh-ge pyeong-beom-han sun-gan-i-deun sang-gwan-eobs-i.'
story.en: 'From now on, as a fan, and just as myself too — I want to stay by your side. Whether you're up on that stage or in a plain, ordinary moment like this, it doesn't matter to me.'

story.text: 하늘은 마지막으로 낮게 웃으며 덧붙였다. '…서툴러도, 이 정도면 분명하죠? 그 인파 속 얼굴 하나가, 결국 여기까지 왔네요.'
story.reading: ha-neul-eun ma-ji-mag-eu-ro naj-ge us-eu-myeo deot-but-yeoss-da. '…seo-tul-leo-do, i jeong-do-myeon bun-myeong-ha-jyo? geu in-pa sog eol-gul ha-na-ga, gyeol-guk yeo-gi-kka-ji wass-ne-yo.'
story.en: Finally, with a low laugh, Haneul added one last thing. '...Even if I'm clumsy at it, this much is clear, right? That one face in the crowd — it ended up bringing me all the way here.'

words.example_en: He finally confessed his true feelings.
He wanted to believe this was fate.
I want to stay by your side from now on too.
His feelings changed starting that day.

sentences.en: He finally confessed his true feelings.
If this was fate, he wanted to believe it.
Every word of it was sincere.
I want to stay by your side from now on too.
It all started from that day.
